notes: 15996 tok/s per GPU under a latency guarantee, still ahead of the full rack's Server figure per GPU (13124). The 2.7% Offline-to-Server discount here sits in the same band as the single-node B300 node's 2.2% and AMD's MI355X node's 3.0%, which is reassuring: at 8-GPU scale the scenario discount IS roughly stable across implementations, and it is only at rack scale that it becomes unstable in both sign and size.
